title: 第27章 巧合第四次
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
周末上午，联邦武道馆。

    安槐一个人来的，苏念念今天被她妈拉去逛商场买换季衣服，临走前发了三条消息叮嘱他把书找到。

    武道馆的三楼乙字区他已经来过一次了，轻车熟路地找到步法类的书架，从最底层抽出了一本《短距突进步·基础篇》。

    这本书是真实存在的，武道馆本来就有，安槐特意查过，内容跟系统商城里那本高度重合，区别在于系统版本有优化路线，实体书没有。

    他打算让苏念念先用实体书打基础，等她练到瓶颈的时候再“偶然”想到一个改良方案帮她调整。

    拿着书往阅览室走的时候，安槐在楼梯转角看到了一个意料之外的人。

    林落雪。

    她站在二楼的功法类书架前，指尖在书脊上缓缓滑过，像是在找什么特定的书。

    身边没有沈晨，没有任何人。

    安槐的脚步放轻了半拍。

    【巧合计数更新：第四次。武道馆是公共场所，周末来的人不少，碰到同学不算离谱。但她出现的时间点和宿主高度重合，概率学上已经不太正常了。】

    安槐没有停留，不紧不慢地走上了三楼。

    他在阅览室坐下来翻书，余光注意到林落雪在二楼待了大约十五分钟后也上了三楼，她走到乙字区的另一端，坐到离安槐四排桌子远的位置，安安静静地看书。

    自始至终没有打招呼。

    安槐把这个细节记了下来。

    她没有主动搭话，说明今天的目的不是社交，那她来做什么？

    答案在她拿的那本书上。

    安槐不动声色地看了一眼她桌上的书封。

    《灵气感知进阶·应用篇》。

    灵气感知。

    她在加强自己的感知能力。

    安槐微微眯了一下眼睛，在球测试的时候，林落雪被系统检测到刻意压制了实际水平，她的灵气感知天赋应该不低，但她在所有人面前都表现得很普通。

    现在她一个人来武道馆看感知类的进阶书籍，说明她在暗中提升自己真正的实力，同时在人前保持伪装。

    一明一暗，两套系统。

    安槐翻了一页手里的步法书，心里把这个信息归档了。

    他没打算做什么，只要她不碰苏念念，她爱藏什么都跟他没关系。

    二十分钟后，安槐把书的核心内容记完，起身离开。

    路过林落雪的桌子时，她微微抬头，露出一个浅浅的笑。

    “安槐同学也来看书？”

    “嗯，帮朋友找资料。”安槐脚步没停。

    “那下次再见了。”

    “再见。”

    礼貌，客气，保持距离。一如既往。

    走出武道馆的大门，秋天的阳光照在脸上，暖烘烘的。

    安槐掏出手机给苏念念发消息。

    “书找到了。”

    苏念念秒回一串感叹号。

    “太好了！！！明天你教我！！！”

    安槐回了个“好”字。

    接着他又发了一条。

    “武道馆碰到林落雪了。”
content_en:
Weekend morning, Federal Martial Arts Hall.

An Huai came alone. Su Niannian was dragged by her mother to the mall today to buy seasonal clothes. Before leaving, she sent three messages asking him to find the book.

He had already been to the B-section on the third floor of the Budokan once. He found the footwork bookshelf with ease and pulled out a book called "Short Distance Progress: Basics" from the bottom.

This book is real. It already exists in the Budokan. An Huai checked it specifically. The content is highly overlapped with the one in the system mall. The difference is that the system version has an optimization route and the physical book does not.

He planned to let Su Niannian use physical books to lay the foundation first, and then "accidentally" come up with an improvement plan to help her adjust when she reaches the bottleneck.

While walking towards the reading room with the book in hand, An Huai saw an unexpected person at the corner of the stairs.

Lin Luoxue.

She stood in front of the exercise bookshelf on the second floor, her fingertips slowly sliding along the spines of the books, as if she was looking for a specific book.

There was no Shen Chen or anyone around him.

An Huai's footsteps slowed down for a moment.

[Coincidence Count Update: Fourth.The Budokan is a public place, and there are many people here on weekends, so it's not too outrageous to bump into classmates.But the time of her appearance highly overlapped with that of the host, which is no longer normal in terms of probability.】

An Huai walked up to the third floor without stopping.

He sat down and flipped through the books in the reading room. From the corner of his eye, he noticed that Lin Luoxue had been on the second floor for about fifteen minutes and then went to the third floor. She walked to the other end of the B-shaped area and sat down four rows away from Anhuai's desk, reading quietly.

No greeting from beginning to end.

An Huai wrote down this detail.

She didn't take the initiative to talk, which meant that the purpose of today was not to socialize, so what was she here to do?

The answer is in the book she holds.

An Huai glanced at the book cover on her desk calmly.

"Advanced Aura Perception·Application".

Aura perception.

She is strengthening her senses.

An Huai narrowed his eyes slightly. During the ball test, Lin Luoxue was detected by the system to have deliberately suppressed her actual level. Her aura perception talent should not be low, but she behaved very ordinary in front of everyone.

Now she comes to the martial arts hall alone to read advanced books on perception, which shows that she is secretly improving her true strength while maintaining a disguise in front of others.

One light and one dark, two systems.

An Huai turned a page of the footwork book in his hand and filed the information away in his mind.

He didn't plan to do anything. As long as she didn't touch Su Niannian, it didn't matter to him what she wanted to hide.

Twenty minutes later, An Huai finished memorizing the core content of the book, stood up and left.

When passing by Lin Luoxue's table, she raised her head slightly and smiled slightly.

"Classmate An Huai also comes to read?"

"Well, I'm helping my friend find information." An Huai kept walking.

"See you next time."

"Goodbye."

Be polite, polite, and keep your distance.as always.

When I walked out of the gate of the martial arts hall, the autumn sunshine shone warmly on my face.

An Huai took out his mobile phone and sent a message to Su Niannian.

"The book was found."

Su Niannian replied with a string of exclamation points in seconds.

"Great!!! You can teach me tomorrow!!!"

An Huai replied with the word "good".

Then he sent another.

"We met Lin Luoxue in the martial arts hall."
